text:
Sam (Finance): Heads-up: our dashboard flagged a sudden GPU cost reallocation in Feb. Looks like ~$11,200 shifted into unallocated buckets. Can Cloud Ops help trace? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Nina (Cloud Ops): ugh. Which billing export? I can run a grouped query.

Sam (Finance): pulled from the daily export: some lines have labels = {} and the project field shows 'sustained-compute'. Quick BQ I used: 
```sql
SELECT project.id, SUM(cost) cost, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT labels) lbls
FROM `redwood-billing.gcp_export.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`
WHERE sku_description LIKE '%GPU%' AND labels = '{}'
GROUP BY project.id
ORDER BY cost DESC;
```

billing-bot: billing export completed 2026-02-28T07:00Z (export_set: feb-end).

Diego (ML Infra): I ran a big hyperparam sweep 2026-02-27 that used ephemeral preemptible pools. Older sweep wrapper didn't add cost_center. That could be ~6.5k.

Nina (Cloud Ops): I also see an autoscaling incident in infra-sandbox on 2026-02-26 where instance templates were created by a CI job without the label hook. That explains ~3.8k.

Sam (Finance): Ok estimate cover: ML team 6.5k, Infra sandbox 3.8k, misc 0.9k. We need a formal allocation for month-end close. Finance needs: csv of instance_ids + owners, proposed journal entries, and confirmation that this won't repeat (alerts or policy).

Diego (ML Infra): I'll export instance IDs and attach owners from experiment metadata. Also will push a PR to the sweep runner to inject labels automatically.

Nina (Cloud Ops): I'll enable a BigQuery daily view that surfaces rows with missing labels and wire an alert to #finance at 6:30am. Also propose an org policy to require 'cost_center' and 'project_team' labels on VM creation.

Sam (Finance): For approval, I'll accept provisional chargebacks if you drop the audit csv in BT-10112 and tag me. We will post adjusting entries after verification.

Priya (Vendor Ops): if any of this touches committed reservations, flag me. Sometimes reservation assignment causes unexpected parent_project mappings and we can request reseller help.

Diego (ML Infra): FYI sweep PR created: infra/ml/sweep-label-fix #342. It auto-adds cost_center=ml and project_team=experiments.

Nina (Cloud Ops): Terraform guard planned: deny compute.instances.insert unless labels.cost_center present. I'll create a staging rollout and request security sign-off.

billing-bot: action logged: created ticket BT-10112 (provisional allocation hold).

Sam (Finance): Great. One more ask: set budgets with alerts at 75/90/100% for the affected projects and email the owners + finance. Proposed amounts: sustained-compute $12,000, infra-sandbox $5,000, experiments $8,000.

Nina (Cloud Ops): will create budgets and alerting. Also adding a day-over-day delta alert for GPU spend > 25% to catch spikes earlier.

Diego (ML Infra): will add a note in the ML runbook about tagging and the new pre-checks.

Sam (Finance): Thanks. Please load the csv by EOD and I'll post the provisional journal. Sync tomorrow 9:30am PT if needed. :thumbsup:
